final: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 END) as male_inpatient, COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 END) as male_outpatient, ROUND(100 * (1 - CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 END) AS REAL) / CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 END) AS REAL)), 2) as deviation_percentage FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'M'
